cli_help.stdout:
usage: cli.py [-h] [--version] {caption,plan,ground} ...

Culture transcreation research CLI.

positional arguments:
  {caption,plan,ground}
    caption             Caption one image with SmolVLM-500M
    plan                Plan cultural edits with local Ollama; never modifies
                        images
    ground              Research-only text localization; never executes
                        planner edits

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

usage: cli.py caption [-h] --image IMAGE [--model {smolvlm}]
                      [--prompt-variant {default,concise_grounded}]
                      [--config CONFIG] [--out OUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --image IMAGE
  --model {smolvlm}
  --prompt-variant {default,concise_grounded}
  --config CONFIG
  --out OUT

usage: cli.py plan [-h] --input INPUT [--config CONFIG] [--model MODEL]
                   [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--out OUT]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT        PlanningInput JSON, including target culture
  --config CONFIG
  --model MODEL        Override the configured Ollama model name
  --endpoint ENDPOINT  Override the local /api/chat URL
  --timeout TIMEOUT    Override request timeout in seconds
  --out OUT            New audit JSON; existing files are preserved

usage: cli.py ground [-h] --image IMAGE --phrase PHRASE [--config CONFIG]
                     [--box-threshold BOX_THRESHOLD]
                     [--text-threshold TEXT_THRESHOLD] [--device {cuda,cpu}]
                     --out OUT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --image IMAGE
  --phrase PHRASE
  --config CONFIG
  --box-threshold BOX_THRESHOLD
  --text-threshold TEXT_THRESHOLD
  --device {cuda,cpu}
  --out OUT             New artifact directory
